quality.title: baseline
quality.question: Pinned healthy trace. Naive and pilot agree when the series is clean.

quality.title: duplicates
quality.question: Replaying the same scrape must not inflate bytes/s.

quality.title: out of order
quality.question: Late/out-of-order arrivals keep observation_time for the interval.

quality.title: gaps
quality.question: Dropped scrapes stay missing, not zero.

quality.title: late samples after restart
quality.question: Delivery delay with preserved observation timestamps, plus a collector restart.

quality.title: unit change
quality.question: Unit change without a new metric id is not a traffic spike.

quality.title: ambiguous discontinuity
quality.question: An unexplained counter drop is uncertain, not an invented rate.

quality.title: linux live healthy
quality.question: Real /proc/<server-pid>/net/dev and TcpRetransSegs from a live Ubuntu netns+veth workload.

incident.title: Injected loss (userspace model, not optical BER)
Receiver CPU restriction (busy thread model, not cgroup)
CPU restriction plus loss — should be insufficient evidence

reproduce: pip install -e ./pilot && python -m pytest -q && python -m pilot run-linux && python -m pilot build-cases
